steps.title: Login to TRA IDARS
steps.instruction: Go to uas.tra.go.tz and log in with your employer TIN and password
steps.instruction_sw: Nenda kwenye uas.tra.go.tz na ingia ukitumia TIN yako ya mwajiri na nenosiri

steps.title: Go to Employment Returns
steps.instruction: Click on 'Returns' in the navigation menu, then select 'Employment Returns'
steps.instruction_sw: Bonyeza 'Returns' kwenye menyu ya urambazaji, kisha chagua 'Marejesho ya Ajira'

steps.title: Select PAYE Return
steps.instruction: From the Employment Returns submenu, click on 'PAYE Return'
steps.instruction_sw: Kutoka kwenye menyu ndogo ya Marejesho ya Ajira, bonyeza 'Marejesho ya PAYE'
steps.success_indicator: PAYE Return form or period selection loaded

steps.title: Select Period and Enter Employees
steps.instruction: Select the tax month, then enter the number of employees and total gross salary paid
steps.instruction_sw: Chagua mwezi wa kodi, kisha weka idadi ya watumishi na jumla ya mshahara mkubwa uliolipwa

steps.title: Submit PAYE Return
steps.instruction: Review the calculated PAYE amount, then click 'Submit' to file the return
steps.instruction_sw: Kagua kiasi cha PAYE kilichohesabiwa, kisha bonyeza 'Tuma' kutuma marejesho
steps.expected_screen: PAYE Return summary with calculated amounts
steps.success_indicator: PAYE return submitted with acknowledgement number shown
